title: Privacy and cookies
description: Cookie preferences, Google Analytics and YouTube on Expedition Creativity.
heading:
Privacy.
Your choice.
lead: You choose whether to allow analytics.

sections.title: Essential storage
sections.body: The website remembers your cookie preference in your browser so it can respect your choice on your next visit.

sections.title: Google Analytics
sections.body: Google Analytics is loaded only with your consent to measure visits and website usage. No advertising cookies are used.

sections.title: YouTube
sections.body: A video connects to YouTube only when you click play. We use youtube-nocookie.com for the player. YouTube’s privacy terms also apply after playback begins.

sections.title: Change your preference
sections.body:
You can reopen Cookie preferences at the bottom of every page. Withdrawing analytics consent stops further measurement.

Questions? Get in touch.

source: Adapted to the consent behaviour of the new site; based on cookie-policy.html
